name: The Inner Voice
about: Inner Voice Short's shadow: a black silhouette with glowing red eyes, the voice in the hero's head.
heightNote: the source skill gives no height: an everyday adult's

can.faceNotes: the hero: the kit's eyes, brows and mouths. The shadow: the kit's slits and smile; the other faces are the app's, in its red line
can.poseNotes: hands and feet as targets of the kit's two-bone limbs (arms, legs / feet); the walk is the app's cycle of those targets
can.walk: the app's foot and hand cycle (the kit has no walk of its own)
can.talk: the mouth o and line by turns; no lip sync
